label: bump_profile_match_version: a published profile edit sets users.searchesResumedAt
Set searchesResumedAt now for users with a published profile

execute.sql:
UPDATE public.users u SET "searchesResumedAt" = now()
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p."userId" = u.id AND p.state = 'published');
